items.html: And what is said in the Idra, that those strands spread until the tops of the shoulders of Arich Anpin — the intention is not above, in Arich Anpin itself; for if so, how could it say "in order to draw to the brain of ZA," when it is very far from them? Rather it is to be understood with what we said above: that the two lower segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin are what are called the tops of its shoulders, which are the two coronets in the Daat of ZA. And there, in the Daat, the place of the standing of the two tops of the shoulders — until there reach the ends of the hairs, and the lights go out from there, and strike and rupture, and enter within the Mochin of ZA. And the true explanation of this language has been given in Birkat Avot of the second day of Rosh Hashanah, in the word "Our G-d and G-d of our fathers." See there.
